description: The woman wears an opaque dark green floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Tan-gold knotwork woven borders frame the neckline, shoulder straps, sleeve edges, front panels and lower hem. Round gold-patterned clasps sit at the shoulders and center waist. A narrow decorated belt has a long central hanging end. A dark green-and-brown checked wrap rests loosely around both forearms and hangs down the sides with fringed edges. The skirt stays closed except for a modest low walking opening. Brown leather shoes show underneath, and her gathered head remains uncovered.
